Page 6 is the only page with imaging costs. It gives these rows:
- "Outpatient X-rays and Ultrasounds" is one cost for two services, so each service gets its own fact with the same quotes. The rows are "Office or freestanding location: $25 copay" and "Outpatient hospital: $75 copay".
- "Office or freestanding location" covers two settings, so office and freestanding each get a fact.
- "Diagnostic Radiology (such as CT, PET Scan, etc.)" is an open-ended list ("such as … etc."), so it maps to `imaging.diagnostic`, not to the advanced benefits. Its costs are "$100 or $200 copay" for office or freestanding and "$200 or $300 copay" for outpatient hospital.

Quotes must occur exactly once on the page:
- "Office or freestanding location: $25 copay" is unique.
- "Outpatient hospital: $75 copay" is unique.
- "Office or freestanding location: $100 or $200 copay" is unique.
- "Outpatient Hospital: $200 or $300 copay" is unique, since the capitalised "Hospital" matches only that row.
- I add the header line "Outpatient X-rays and Ultrasounds" as a second quote to show the service name.
